UDrawingObjects.pas::ToByte.text: Truncates a number to the low 8 bits, as C stores a BYTE read from a file.

UDrawingObjects.pas::ToWord.text: Truncates a number to the low 16 bits, as C stores a WORD.

UDrawingObjects.pas::ToInt16.text: Truncates a number to a signed 16 bit value, as C stores a short.

TDocOptionsBase.Create.text: Creates the options every sheet carries: fonts, line styles, fill styles, user colors, snap grid, default text metrics, zoom and the editing settings (auto junction on, auto snap on, snap range 15).

TDocOptionsBase.TextExtent.text: Measures text in a font resource with the sheet's text metrics.
TDocOptionsBase.TextExtent.returns: width and height in design units

TDocOptionsBase.Destroy.text: Frees the resource tables, snap settings and text metrics.

TDocOptionsBase.UnTagAll.text: Marks all fonts, line styles and fill styles as unused before a save.

TDocOptionsBase.AddStyle.text: Finds or adds a line style (dash style, thickness, color).
TDocOptionsBase.AddStyle.returns: the style number to store in an object

TDocOptionsBase.AddFillStyle.text: Finds or adds a fill style.
TDocOptionsBase.AddFillStyle.returns: the fill number to store in an object

RemapAndReAddStyle.text: Converts a style number from a file and re-adds that style as a new entry, as TinyCAD does so a loaded object gets its own style number.

params.FileStyle: the style number as written in the file

TDrawingList.Create.text: Creates a list that owns the objects in it.

TDrawingObject.BeginTag.text: Starts an object's XML element and writes its stable id (oid) when it has one. Every object's SaveXML starts with this.

ObjectXMLText.text: An object's XML as text, used to compare objects.

TDrawingObject.SameAs.text: Whether another object is the same: identical XML.

TDrawLine.XMLTagFor.text: The XML element name for a kind of line: BUS, WIRE, or LINE.

AddPolyBezier.text: Adds the flattened points of one curved polygon segment (a Bezier approximating an elliptical arc) to a point buffer, as TinyCAD flattens arcs.

params.Count: number of points in the buffer (updated)

TDrawPolygon.FlattenPath.text: Converts the polygon's handles (corners and arcs) into the plain list of points used to draw and hit-test it.

TDrawPolygon.CalcBoundingRect.text: Flattens the path, makes the first handle the origin, and sets the object's bounding rectangle (PointA, PointB).

TDrawSquare.IsSquare.text: Whether this is a rectangle (True) or an ellipse (False).

TDrawPin.IsPower.text: Whether this is a hidden power pin (Which = 4).

CopyPoints.text: Copies the two defining points from one object to another (used by Clone).

TDrawingObject.Shift.text: Moves the object by a vector (both points).

params.R: how far to move in x and y

TDrawingObject.IsCompletelyInside.text: Whether the object's bounding box lies entirely inside a rectangle.
TDrawingObject.IsCompletelyInside.returns: True if it is completely inside

TDrawPolygon.IsInsidePolygon.text: Point-in-polygon test using the flattened outline and a horizontal ray (even-odd rule).
TDrawPolygon.IsInsidePolygon.returns: True if the point is inside

TDrawPolygon.IsInsideLine.text: Whether any edge of the flattened outline touches a rectangle.
TDrawPolygon.IsInsideLine.returns: True if the outline touches it

TDrawPolygon.FindNearestSegment.text: Finds which flattened line, and which handle, are nearest a point (used to insert a handle or pick a segment).

params.Line: set to the nearest flattened line
params.Handle: set to the handle that line belongs to

PointInRect.text: Whether a point is inside or on the edge of a rectangle given by its edges.

TDrawSquare.EllipseDistanceFromPoint.text: Distance from a point to the edge of the ellipse, found by mapping the ellipse onto a unit circle.

params.Inside: set True when the point is inside the ellipse

PowerStemEnd.text: Where a power symbol's stem ends (a fixed length from its connection point in its direction).

TDrawPin.IsInvisible.text: Whether the pin is hidden: when editing a library symbol, pins of other parts; on a drawing, power pins.

TDrawPin.DetermineLayout.text: Works out where the pin's line, dot, clock mark, name and number go for a rotation / mirror state (a transcription of TinyCAD's pin layout code).

TDrawPin.DetermineSize.text: Sets the pin's second point so its box covers the line and the text; hidden pins and zero-length pins have no size.

TDrawPin.ConvertPowerToNormal.text: Turns a hidden power pin into a normal pin and remembers it was converted (used when a symbol shows its power pins).

TSnapSettings.Create.text: Creates grid settings with TinyCAD's defaults.

TSnapSettings.SaveXML.text: Writes the GRID element (spacing times ten, and the snap flag).

TSnapSettings.LoadXML.text: Reads the GRID element (spacing divided by ten, as TinyCAD does even when it is absent).

TSnapSettings.Snap@double.text: Snaps one coordinate to the grid (unchanged when snapping is off).

TSnapSettings.Snap@tdpoint.text: Snaps a point to the grid.

TSymbolView.Create.text: Creates an empty view: no objects and invalid reference point, size and origin.

PointLess.text: Tolerant point ordering (like CDPoint::operator<) used to sort points.
PointLess.returns: True if A sorts before B

TDrawMethod.GetSymbolData.text: The symbol definition this placed symbol uses (from the sheet's symbol table).

TDrawMethod.GetTr.text: The symbol's size for this placement: its definition's size times the placement's scaling.

TDrawMethod.ExtractSymbol.text: Gets the drawing to paint or connect for this symbol (the cached view for its part and power setting) and its size, and updates this object's bounding box.
TDrawMethod.ExtractSymbol.returns: False if there is no drawing

params.Objects: set to the view's objects (owned by the symbol)

TDrawMethod.ScalePoint.text: Applies this placement's x and y scaling to a point.

TDrawMethod.TranslatePointToDesign.text: Converts a point in the symbol's own coordinates to a position on the sheet, applying scaling, rotation, mirror and the placement position. Pin connection points use this.

params.P: a point in the symbol's coordinates

TDrawMethod.ActivePoints.text: The sheet positions of the symbol's visible pins (its connection points).
TDrawMethod.ActivePoints.returns: the points, one per visible pin

TDrawMethod.NewRotation.text: Recalculates where the reference, name and other field texts go after the symbol is placed or rotated: hidden fields are stacked beside the symbol (NewRotation in TinyCAD).

TDrawMethod.GetFirstStaticPoint.text: The position of the symbol's first pin on the sheet, the point that stays put when a symbol is replaced by another.

TDrawMethod.ReplaceSymbol.text: Swaps the placed symbol for another definition, keeping its first pin where it was and (optionally) its field values.

params.KeepOldFields: True to keep field values with matching names

TDrawMethod.GetField.text: The text of a field (reference, name, others); the reference gets a part letter for multi-part symbols.

params.Which: field number (0 reference, 1 name, then others)

TDrawMethod.GetDecoratedField.text: The text to show for a field, following its display type: hidden fields give empty text, others may include the field name or be shown only when not empty.
TDrawMethod.GetDecoratedField.returns: the text to draw, empty if not shown

TDrawMethod.IsFieldVisible.text: Whether a field of a given display type is shown for a value (hidden types never; "if not empty" types only when there is a value).

TDrawMethod.CreateFromSymbol.text: Creates a placed symbol from a symbol definition: its part, fields (from the definition's defaults) and rotation.

params.ASymbolId: symbol number in the sheet's table

TDrawPin.GetActivePoint.text: The pin's connection point on the sheet, given the symbol that holds it.

TDrawPower.GetValue.text: The power symbol's text (its net name when set).

TDrawMethod.GetRef.text: The reference field's raw value (e.g. R1) with no part letter; the netlist uses it.

TDrawMethod.GetFieldCount.text: Number of fields (reference, name and the extras).

TDrawMethod.GetNetlistHint.text: The net number remembered for a pin (0 if none). As in TinyCAD, asking about a new pin adds it to the hint list with 0.

TDrawMethod.SetNetlistHint.text: Remembers the net number of a pin so net numbers stay stable between netlist runs; saved with the design as HINT.

TDrawLadder.RailTop.text: y of the top of the rails.

TDrawLadder.RailBottom.text: y of the bottom of the rails.

TDrawLadder.Pitch.text: Spacing between lines: the rails' height divided by the number of lines.

TDrawLadder.RungY.text: The y of the middle of a line (each line owns an equal band of the height).

TDrawLadder.NumberAt.text: The line number shown for a line: the first line is the start number, the last is the stop number and the rest are spread evenly between them, rounded.

TDrawLadder.RungAtY.text: Which line a height falls in.
TDrawLadder.RungAtY.returns: the 0-based line, or -1 when outside the rails

TDrawLadder.LineNumberAtY.text: The line number at a height: the basis of line number awareness.
TDrawLadder.LineNumberAtY.returns: False when the height is outside the rails

params.Number: set to the line number (0 outside)

TDrawLadder.ShowsLeftNumbers.text: Whether numbers are drawn left of the left rail (side 0 or both).

TDrawLadder.ShowsRightNumbers.text: Whether numbers are drawn right of the right rail (side 1 or both).

TDrawLadder.NumberBox.text: The box a line number occupies (needs the text metrics): right-aligned against the left rail or left-aligned against the right rail, centred on the line.

params.RightSide: True for the right rail's number

TDrawLadder.LeftLabelBox.text: The box of the left bus wire number, centred above the left rail.

TDrawLadder.RightLabelBox.text: The box of the right bus wire number, centred above the right rail.

BoxContains.text: Whether a point is inside a box (edges included).

BoxesOverlap.text: Whether a box overlaps a rectangle given by its edges.

TDrawMeasure.LengthInUnits.text: The distance between the two points in the object's units (millimetres or inches).

TDrawMeasure.DisplayText.text: The distance as text with its unit, e.g. "125.4 mm" or "4.937 in".

TDrawRefText.DisplayText.text: The text shown: prefix, resolved value and suffix.

CreateObjectForTag.text: Makes an empty object for an XML element name (WIRE, JUNCTION, SYMBOL, LADDER ...).
CreateObjectForTag.returns: the object, or nil for an unknown tag

params.Opts: the sheet options the object belongs to

IsKnownUnsupportedObjectTag.text: Whether a tag belongs to a TinyCAD object this port does not load (TAG, METAFILE, hierarchical symbols); such elements are skipped rather than reported as errors.
IsKnownUnsupportedObjectTag.returns: True if the tag is known but unsupported

LoadObjectTag.text: Reads one object element into a list: makes the object, reads its id and properties, and drops it if it turns out empty. Only the first ORIGIN is accepted.
LoadObjectTag.returns: True normally; False if the element could not be read

params.R: the XML reader on the element

SaveObjects.text: Writes the objects of a list as XML; construction objects only in the details form and errors never; the origin object only when asked.

params.Details: True when saving a sheet (including construction objects), False for a symbol
params.SaveOriginObject: True to write the origin object
